title: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 1.1.1: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

steps.name: Check if the audit target is a Windows system with Group Policy Management available
steps.function: 1. Check if the audit target is a Windows system with Group Policy Management available using command: `Get-Command Get-GPO -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`. Expected result: The command returns a valid cmdlet object.

steps.name: Check if the 'Enforce password history' policy is set to '24 or more password(s)'
steps.function: 2. Check if the 'Enforce password history' policy is set to '{{ password_history_min }} or more password(s)' using command: `Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy | Select-Object -ExpandProperty HistoryLength`. Expected result: The value is {{ password_history_min }} or greater.

steps.name: Check if the 'Enforce password history' policy is configured via the Default Domain Policy GPO
steps.function: 3. Check if the 'Enforce password history' policy is configured via the Default Domain Policy GPO using command: `Get-GPO -Name "Default Domain Policy" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty GpoStatus`. Expected result: The GPO status is 'Enabled' or 'AllSettingsEnabled'.

steps.name: Check if the 'Enforce password history' setting in the Default Domain Policy GPO is set to '24 or more password(s)'
steps.function: 4. Check if the 'Enforce password history' setting in the Default Domain Policy GPO is set to '{{ password_history_min }} or more password(s)' using command: `Get-GPO -Name "Default Domain Policy" | Get-GPOReport -ReportType Xml | Select-String -Pattern 'Enforce password history' -Context 0,5`. Expected result: The XML report contains a setting for 'Enforce password history' with a value of {{ password_history_min }} or greater.

steps.name: Check if the 'Minimum password age' policy is set to a value that prevents users from repeatedly changing passwords (to…
steps.function: 5. Check if the 'Minimum password age' policy is set to a value that prevents users from repeatedly changing passwords (to support password history effectiveness) using command: `Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy | Select-Object -ExpandProperty MinPasswordAge`. Expected result: The value is greater than 0 days.

steps.name: Overall compliance status: PASS if all above checks pass, SKIP if the system is not a domain controller or Active…
steps.function: 6. Overall compliance status: PASS if all above checks pass, SKIP if the system is not a domain controller or Active Directory is not present, FAIL if the feature exists but the password history is set to less than {{ password_history_min }} or not configured via Default Domain Policy.

steps.name: Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance…
steps.function: 7. Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) derived from the last requirement's status variable.

steps.name: Create a task named 'Generate audit report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
steps.function:
8. Create a task named 'Generate audit report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
AUDIT REPORT — CIS 1.1.1
Reference: CIS Benchmark checkpoint 1.1.1
Then for each requirement: REQUIREMENT NN - {{ req_NN }}:
  With fields: Task, Command, Exit code, Data, Status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR), Details.
End with OVERALL COMPLIANCE: section containing Result: {{{ cis_result }}}

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: Output the overall compliance status to the caller.

steps.function: Reached via rescue block on any unexpected task failure.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all audit tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all checks complete and report status
If the audit targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, report SKIP for all checks.
This is an AUDIT playbook — it MUST NOT make any changes to the system. All tasks must be read-only (shell commands, stat, slurp, command with check-only flags, etc.).
reference_procedure: Navigate to the UI Path articulated in the Remediation section and confirm it is set as prescribed.
